goal: Avoid copying the unbroadcast transaction ID set under the mempool lock just to count them in getmempoolinfo
Reduces unnecessary heap allocations and lock holding time when reading mempool info
agreement: No review feedback or discussion yet

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it eliminates redundant set copies under the mempool lock
Benchmark shows large runtime reductions with 10k IDs, but unbroadcast sets are rarely that large in practice
